content:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:5173/ and thoroughly test and inspect the AgriSense (KrishiMitra) Intelligent Farming Assistance Platform application:
1. Inspect the homepage: Check the top sticky navbar, AgriSense brand logo, helpline banner (1800-180-1551), hero headline, and the Quick Local Weather & Soil Snapshot Widget.
2. Test the Language Selector dropdown in the navbar: Switch between English, Hindi (हिंदी), Assamese (অসমীয়া), and Spanish (Español). Confirm that headings, buttons, and form labels dynamically update across the application.
3. Test the District / Location selector in the Weather widget (e.g. switch between Punjab, Assam, Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Spain) and verify the 7-day trend chart updates.
4. Scroll to the Smart Crop Recommendation Engine: Adjust the Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium sliders and pH slider. Switch seasons (Kharif / Rabi / Zaid). Click on "View Complete Farming Plan" on the top ranked crop (e.g. Rice, Wheat, Tomato) and confirm the modal displays the 5-phase timeline, seed rate, fertilizer schedule, and pest warnings. Close the modal.
5. Scroll to the Seasonal Farming Calendar: Click across the season tabs (All Seasons, Kharif, Rabi, Zaid) and verify the timeline cards and checklist checkboxes.
6. Scroll to the Crop Doctor: Select a crop (e.g. Tomato or Rice), click on symptoms (or sample leaf photo), click "Analyze Symptoms & Diagnose", and verify the diagnostic report, organic remedy, and chemical treatment.
7. Scroll to Mandi & Schemes: Test the search filter on the Mandi prices table, and click "View Application Steps" on a government scheme (e.g. PM-KISAN or PMFBY) to verify the modal. Close the modal.
8. Click on "Ask Krishi AI" (floating button or navbar CTA) to open the AI Agronomist drawer. Click one of the quick prompt chips (e.g. "Best fertilizer for paddy in clay soil?"), test simulated voice input, and verify the AI response is displayed.
9. Verify there are no console errors, broken images, or visual layout glitches. Report your findings in detail.
